verdict.rationale: A probe confirms llms.txt is live at https://docs.usebruno.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with a structured doc index, and Bruno also documents AGENTS.md guidance for Codex and agent-oriented integration docs (Cursor, VS Code Copilot) explicitly aimed at pointing agents at its docs/collections. missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents actually consume llms.txt successfully in practice, and no evidence of an OpenAPI spec to complement it.
